source-diagnostics.title: Source diagnostics
source-diagnostics.description: Check source access through the direct network, the source proxy, and strict or relaxed TLS verification. Probes do not save configuration.

source.label: Select source
source.savedSummary: Saved sources use their complete backend configuration; this page shows redacted details only.

errors.load: Could not load the source list
errors.invalidTimeout: Timeout must be an integer from 3 through 30.

recommendation.none: A recommendation appears after a probe completes.
recommendation.disable: Consider disabling for this source only
recommendation.notApplicable: Not applicable or keep current value
recommendation.securityWarning: Disabling certificate verification removes server identity checks and can permit a man-in-the-middle attack.
recommendation.relaxedSuccessContext: A relaxed-mode success during a full check only shows that mode is usable; it is not a reason to disable certificate verification when strict mode succeeds.
recommendation.onlyThisSource: Apply this setting only to the current source; article and media downloads continue to use strict verification.

codes.direct_strict: The direct network works with strict certificate verification.
codes.proxy_strict: The source proxy works with strict certificate verification.
codes.direct_relaxed: The direct network works only when certificate verification is disabled.
codes.proxy_relaxed: The source proxy works only when certificate verification is disabled.
codes.invalid_feed: The source is reachable, but its response is not a supported feed.
